lines.reason: The only formed fold is plate (patches 1/2) to tab (3/4), about 90.4 deg. In perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the label sits on the outer-arc apex: its offset along the bisector is -0.05, +0.02 and +0.02 mm, and the nearest scan point is 0.06, 0.33 and 0.18 mm away. The line is parallel to the fold. The face-on and side close-ups show it running from tab edge to tab edge (16.7 mm, the full fold width up to the relief slot). Seen on 12 global views, 3 close-ups and the sections, plus the originals (contact sheet, closeup_B1, patch sheet).
